question: Who is the author of the book called 'Beneath the Surface: My Story'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Michael Phelps**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Michael Phelps** is a former competitive swimmer from the United States.
 
• He is the most decorated Olympian of all time with a total of 28 medals.
 
• Phelps published his autobiography, **'Beneath the Surface: My Story'**, which gives an insight into his life and career.
 
• The book covers his journey, including his struggles with mental health and his achievements in swimming.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Michael Phelps' Achievements:**

 
 
• Phelps has won 23 gold medals, 3 silver, and 2 bronze medals in the Olympics.
 
• He holds the record for the most Olympic gold medals in individual events (13).
 
 
 
• **Mental Health Advocacy:**
 
 
• Phelps has been open about his struggles with depression and anxiety.
 
• He is an advocate for mental health awareness and has spoken publicly about the importance of seeking help.
 
 
 
• **Philanthropy:**
 
 
• He established the Michael Phelps Foundation in 2008.
 
• The foundation focuses on promoting water safety, healthy living, and the pursuit of dreams.
 
 
 
• **Other Publications:**
 
 
• In addition to 'Beneath the Surface', Phelps has also published another book, 'No Limits: The Will to Succeed'.
 
• 'No Limits' provides a deeper look into his training regimen and mindset during his competitive years.
